legal.draft_notice: Draft — this summary describes what the platform does today and is pending legal review.
legal.p_collect: Your name, phone number, city and — depending on your role — company or office details, vehicle details, national ID, bank IBAN and the documents you upload for verification.
legal.p_use: To sign you in, match drivers with jobs, verify accounts, calculate and pay settlements, resolve complaints and keep the platform safe. Staff actions on your data are recorded in an audit log.
legal.p_share: A driver sees the pickup, delivery and recipient details only after accepting a job, and only while it is active. A business sees a driver's name and phone only after the driver accepts. Offices see their own drivers. Platform staff see what their role permits.
legal.p_location: Drivers share their location only while they choose to be online or have an active job, and only after giving explicit consent in the app. Location is shown to operations staff for dispatch and safety.
legal.p_whatsapp: The app can open WhatsApp with a prefilled message to the recipient. You must press send yourself; the platform cannot see whether a message was delivered or read.
legal.p_rights: You can edit your profile at any time and contact support to correct or request deletion of your data. Retention periods are being finalised.

intg.provider.logestechs.label: LogesTech
intg.provider.logestechs.desc: Find LogesTech packages by barcode or invoice number, follow their status and keep both systems in step.
intg.provider.logestechs.limits: LogesTech lets JR look a package up by barcode or invoice number, tell you when its status changes, and, only if you switch it on, cancel a package or ask for it to be returned. It cannot give JR a list of your packages and it cannot be told that a package was delivered. So you add parcels by typing, pasting or scanning their barcodes.
intg.provider.webhook.label: Custom system (webhook)
intg.provider.webhook.desc: Any other warehouse or order system that can send a small message when a status changes. JR can also send parcel outcomes back to it.
intg.provider.webhook.limits: JR cannot look parcels up in this system, so you add parcels yourself. Your system sends status changes to JR, and JR can report delivered, failed, returned and cancelled parcels back, if you turn that on.
